DOC-01.title: Building campaign triggers with the rule builder
DOC-01.text:
# Building campaign triggers with the rule builder

Doc ID: DOC-01 · Source: Confluence · Last updated: 2026-11-18 · Audience: all customers

## What changed in 4.12
Campaign trigger rules now live in the rule builder (Campaigns > Triggers > Rule builder). Existing rules were migrated automatically. Nothing needs to be rebuilt.

The trigger "On survey complete" is now called **"Response received"**. It behaves exactly as before. Saved filters and reports that used the old name keep working.

## Checking your migrated rules
1. Open Campaigns > Triggers > Rule builder.
2. Each migrated rule shows a "Migrated" badge for 30 days.
3. Open the rule and confirm the conditions match what you expect.

## Building a new rule
1. Click **New rule** and pick a trigger event, for example "Response received".
2. Add conditions such as score range, location or agent.
3. Choose the campaign to start and save.

## Tips for admins
- Rules with more than five conditions run slightly slower. Split them into two rules if you can.
- Teams that train new agents on triggers should update their training material to use the new name.

DOC-02.title: Reminder settings for campaigns
DOC-02.text:
# Reminder settings for campaigns

Doc ID: DOC-02 · Source: Confluence · Last updated: 2026-11-18 · Audience: all customers

## What changed in 4.12
The default reminder interval is now **5 days** (previously 3 days). Campaigns that already have a custom interval are not affected.

## Who will notice
Any campaign using the default setting now sends fewer reminders. Response rates may dip slightly in the first weeks; customers who had complained about too many reminders will see fewer.

## Keeping the old interval
1. Open the campaign and go to Settings > Reminders.
2. Choose **Custom interval** and set it to 3 days.
3. Save. The setting applies to reminders scheduled after the save.

## Setting an account-wide default
Admins can set a default for all new campaigns under Admin > Campaign defaults > Reminder interval.

DOC-03.title: Adding an NPS slider question
DOC-03.text:
# Adding an NPS slider question

Doc ID: DOC-03 · Source: Confluence · Last updated: 2026-11-17 · Audience: all customers

## What's new in 4.12
The survey builder has a new question type: **NPS slider**. Respondents drag a slider from 0 to 10. The layout is designed for phones first and works on desktop.

## Adding the question
1. Open a survey in the survey builder.
2. Click **Add question** > **NPS slider**.
3. Edit the question text and the labels at each end (for example "Not likely" and "Very likely").
4. Preview and publish.

## Reporting
NPS slider answers feed the same NPS score and reports as the existing NPS question. Customers can switch an existing NPS question to the slider without losing past responses.

DOC-04.title: Switching review widgets from grid to carousel
DOC-04.text:
# Switching review widgets from grid to carousel

Doc ID: DOC-04 · Source: Confluence · Last updated: 2026-11-19 · Audience: all customers

## What changed in 4.12
A new **carousel** layout is available for review widgets. The **grid** layout is deprecated and will be removed at the end of the current quarter (31 December 2026). After that date, grid widgets stop displaying.

## Who needs to act
Any site still using a grid widget must switch before 31 December 2026.

## How to switch
1. Go to Widgets > My widgets and filter by Layout: Grid.
2. Open each widget and choose **Layout: Carousel**.
3. Adjust the number of cards shown and the colours to match your site.
4. Click **Publish**. The embed code does not change, so no website update is needed.

## Known limits
- The carousel shows up to 12 reviews.
- Custom CSS written for the grid layout does not carry over and needs redoing.

DOC-05.title: Exporting dashboards
DOC-05.text:
# Exporting dashboards

Doc ID: DOC-05 · Source: Confluence · Last updated: 2026-06-10 · Audience: all customers

## Export formats
Dashboards can be exported as **PDF** or **CSV**.

- **PDF** keeps the charts and layout and is best for board packs and monthly reviews.
- **CSV** gives the raw numbers for further analysis in a spreadsheet.

## How to export
1. Open the dashboard.
2. Click **Export** in the top right.
3. Choose PDF or CSV and the date range.
4. The file downloads, or is emailed to you if it is large.

## Scheduling exports
Admins can schedule a weekly or monthly export under Reports > Scheduled exports.

DOC-06.title: Salesforce sync settings
DOC-06.text:
# Salesforce sync settings

Doc ID: DOC-06 · Source: Confluence · Last updated: 2026-11-16 · Audience: all customers

## What changed in 4.12
Salesforce sync now runs **every hour** instead of every 15 minutes. This keeps accounts within Salesforce API limits and reduces failed syncs.

## Who will notice
Teams that act on survey responses inside Salesforce will see new records up to an hour later than before.

## Urgent records
Admins can push records immediately with **Sync now** under Integrations > Salesforce. Sync now can be used up to 10 times a day.

## Checking sync health
Integrations > Salesforce > Sync log shows each run, the records sent and any errors.

DOC-07.title: Rotating your SAML certificate
DOC-07.text:
# Rotating your SAML certificate

Doc ID: DOC-07 · Source: Confluence · Last updated: 2026-11-19 · Audience: all customers

## Action required
Customers using SAML single sign-on must upload the new certificate **before 15 January 2027**. After that date, logins through SAML will fail until the new certificate is in place.

## Who must act
Your IT or identity team. They will need admin access to your identity provider (for example Okta or Azure AD).

## Steps
1. In the app, go to Admin > Security > SSO and download the new certificate.
2. In your identity provider, add the new certificate to the app's SAML settings.
3. Back in the app, click **Test login**.
4. When the test passes, click **Activate new certificate**.

## If something goes wrong
Admins can still sign in with a password-and-code login to fix the settings. Contact support if the test keeps failing.

DOC-08.title: Branded SSO login page – Bluepeak Mortgages
DOC-08.text:
# Branded SSO login page – Bluepeak Mortgages

Doc ID: DOC-08 · Source: Google Drive · Last updated: 2026-11-15 · Audience: **Bluepeak Mortgages only — do not share with other customers**

## What we built
Bluepeak's SSO login page now shows the Bluepeak logo and colours, and a "Need help signing in?" link to Bluepeak's IT helpdesk. This was requested by Bluepeak's IT team.

## What Bluepeak users will see
- The Bluepeak logo above the sign-in button.
- Bluepeak's blue colour scheme.
- A helpdesk link that opens Bluepeak's internal IT portal.

## What Bluepeak's admin can change
Admin > Security > SSO > Login page lets the admin replace the logo, change the helpdesk link, or switch back to the standard page.

## Related
Bluepeak also uses SAML SSO, so the certificate rotation in DOC-07 applies to them as well.

DOC-09.title: Dealer-group roll-up view – Silverline Motors pilot
DOC-09.text:
# Dealer-group roll-up view – Silverline Motors pilot

Doc ID: DOC-09 · Source: Google Drive · Last updated: 2026-11-14 · Audience: **Silverline Motors only — do not share with other customers**

## What we built
A roll-up view in reporting that combines the dashboards of several branches under one parent dealer group. Silverline asked for it to run their monthly dealer-group reviews in one place.

## How to use it
1. Open Reporting > Dashboards.
2. Choose **View: Dealer-group roll-up**.
3. Pick the parent group. Scores and response counts are combined across its branches, with a per-branch breakdown below.

## Limits during the pilot
- Enabled for Silverline Motors only.
- Roll-ups can be exported as CSV.
- No date has been set for making this available to other customers. Do not mention timing to anyone outside Silverline.

pages.html:
[Company logo] For all customers · Release v4.12.0

Release Notes: v4.12.0

Released 22 November 2026 · Prepared for All customers

Summary

Release 4.12.0 includes one action for customers who use SAML single sign-on. It adds a new NPS slider question type and a carousel layout for review widgets. It also changes how campaign triggers, reminders, dashboard exports and Salesforce sync work, and includes fixes and speed improvements.

Action required

  • Upload the new SAML certificate (by 15 January 2027): If you use SAML single sign-on, you must upload the new certificate. If you do not, logins through SAML will fail. Your IT or identity team should download the new certificate in the app under Admin > Security > SSO, add it in your identity provider, then test the login and activate the new certificate. Admins can still sign in with a password-and-code login to fix settings if needed.

New features

  • NPS slider question: The survey builder has a new NPS slider question. Respondents drag a slider on a 0-10 scale. The layout works well on phones. You can add it from Add question > NPS slider. Answers feed the same NPS score and reports as the existing NPS question. No action is needed.

Changes

  • Campaign triggers move to the new rule builder: Campaign trigger rules now live in a new rule builder. The "On survey complete" trigger is now called "Response received". Your existing rules were migrated automatically, so you do not need to rebuild them. We suggest checking your migrated rules, and updating any training material that uses the old name.
  • Default reminder interval is now 5 days: Campaigns without a custom reminder setting now send reminders every 5 days instead of every 3 days. This applies to new and existing campaigns. Campaigns with a custom interval are not affected. If you want to keep the old timing, set a custom interval of 3 days in the campaign's reminder settings.
  • Review widgets: new carousel layout, grid layout being removed: A new carousel layout is available for review widgets. The grid layout will be removed at the end of the quarter. If your site uses a grid widget, switch it to the carousel layout before then. Custom styling written for the grid layout will not carry over.
  • Dashboard export is CSV only: PDF export from dashboards has been removed. You can now export dashboards as CSV only. If you used PDF exports, plan to use CSV instead.
  • Salesforce sync now runs hourly: Salesforce sync now runs every hour instead of every 15 minutes. This reduces the chance of reaching Salesforce limits. Teams that work on survey responses in Salesforce may see new records up to an hour later than before.

Fixes and improvements

  • Escalation emails no longer sent twice: Escalation emails were being sent twice. They are now sent once. No action is needed.
  • Large reports load faster: Large reports now load up to 40% faster. No action is needed.
  • Scheduled campaigns use the correct time zone: Scheduled campaigns were sending in the wrong time zone. They now send in your account's time zone. No action is needed.
  • Survey preview loads faster: The survey preview now loads in under two seconds. No action is needed.

Need help?

If you have questions about this release, contact our support team.

Release Notes | Release v4.12.0 | 22 November 2026

[Company logo] Prepared for Bluepeak Mortgages · Confidential · Release v4.12.0

Release Notes: v4.12.0

Released 22 November 2026 · Prepared for Bluepeak Mortgages

Hello Bluepeak Mortgages team,

Summary

Release v4.12.0 includes one action for your team: upload the new SAML certificate before 15 January 2027. It also brings a branded SSO login page for Bluepeak Mortgages, a new rule builder for campaign triggers, and an hourly Salesforce sync. Large reports load faster, and scheduled campaigns now send in your account's time zone.

Action required

  • Upload the new SAML certificate (by 15 January 2027): Bluepeak Mortgages uses SAML SSO, so this affects your sign-ins. You must upload the new certificate before 15 January 2027. After that date, SAML logins will fail until the new certificate is in place. Your IT or identity team should do this. In the app, go to Admin > Security > SSO and download the new certificate. Add it to the app's SAML settings in your identity provider. Then return to the app and click Test login. When the test passes, click Activate new certificate. If something goes wrong, admins can still sign in with a password-and-code login to fix the settings. Contact support if the test keeps failing.

New features

  • Branded SSO login page for Bluepeak Mortgages: Your SSO login page now shows the Bluepeak logo and colours. It also has a "Need help signing in?" link to your IT helpdesk. This is enabled only on your account. Your SAML SSO setup is not changed by this, but the certificate action above still applies. Your admin can replace the logo, change the helpdesk link, or switch back to the standard page under Admin > Security > SSO > Login page.

Changes

  • Campaign triggers move to the new rule builder: Trigger rules now live in a new rule builder, under Campaigns > Triggers > Rule builder. Your existing campaign trigger rules were migrated automatically, so nothing needs to be rebuilt. The "On survey complete" trigger is now called "Response received" and behaves as before. Saved filters and reports that used the old name keep working, which matters for your reporting. Migrated rules show a "Migrated" badge for 30 days. We suggest opening them to confirm the conditions look right. If you train staff on triggers, update your training material to use the new name.
  • Salesforce sync now runs hourly: The Salesforce sync now runs every hour instead of every 15 minutes. This keeps accounts within Salesforce limits and reduces failed syncs. If your teams act on survey responses in Salesforce, new records may appear up to an hour later than before. For urgent records, admins can use Sync now under Integrations > Salesforce, up to 10 times a day. The Sync log in the same place shows each run and any errors.

Fixes and improvements

  • Faster report loading: Large reports now load up to 40% faster. This applies to the reporting you already use. Your CSV dashboard export setting is unchanged.
  • Scheduled campaigns use the account time zone: Scheduled campaigns now send in your account's time zone. If you have scheduled campaigns, we suggest checking that your upcoming scheduled sends are timed as you expect.

Need help?

If you have questions about this release, please contact our support team.

Release Notes | Release v4.12.0 | 22 November 2026

pages.html:
[Company logo] Prepared for Silverline Motors · Confidential · Release v4.12.0

Release Notes: v4.12.0

Released 22 November 2026 · Prepared for Silverline Motors

Hello Silverline Motors team,

Summary

Release v4.12.0 brings three changes to reporting. Silverline Motors gets a new dealer-group roll-up view, dashboard export is now CSV only, and large reports load up to 40% faster. The export change affects your current PDF export setting.

New features

  • Dealer-group roll-up view in reporting: Reporting now has a roll-up view that combines your branch dashboards under one parent dealer group. It is enabled for Silverline Motors only in this release. You can use it for your monthly dealer-group reviews. To try it, open Reporting > Dashboards, choose the dealer-group roll-up view, and pick your parent group. Scores and response counts are combined across branches, with a per-branch breakdown below. Roll-ups can be exported as CSV. Wider availability is not yet scheduled. This does not change your review widgets, which stay on the badge layout.

Changes

  • Dashboard export is CSV only: PDF export from dashboards is removed. Exports are now available as CSV only. Your dashboard export is currently set to PDF, so you will no longer be able to export dashboards in that format. Use CSV instead. CSV gives you the numbers, so charts and layout from a PDF will not be included. This change does not affect your review widgets or their badge layout.

Fixes and improvements

  • Faster report loading: Large reports now load up to 40% faster. This applies to your reporting, including large reports you open for your dashboards. You do not need to do anything.

Need help?

If you have questions about this release, please contact our support team.

Support FAQ

Replies the support team can paste, built from the general release note. Each answer passed the content checks.

Do I need to do anything for SAML single sign-on in this release?

Yes, if you use SAML single sign-on. You must upload the new SAML certificate by 15 January 2027. If you do not, logins through SAML will fail.

How do I upload the new SAML certificate?

Your IT or identity team should download the new certificate in the app under Admin > Security > SSO, add it in your identity provider, then test the login and activate the new certificate. Admins can still sign in with a password-and-code login to fix settings if needed.

What is the new NPS slider question and how do I add it?

It is a new survey question type where respondents drag a slider on a 0-10 scale. The layout works well on phones. Add it from Add question > NPS slider. Answers feed the same NPS score and reports as the existing NPS question. No action is needed.

I can't find the "On survey complete" campaign trigger. Where did it go?

Campaign trigger rules now live in a new rule builder, and "On survey complete" is now called "Response received". Your existing rules were migrated automatically, so you do not need to rebuild them. We suggest checking your migrated rules and updating any training material that uses the old name.

Why are my campaign reminders going out less often?

The default reminder interval is now 5 days instead of 3 days. This applies to new and existing campaigns that have no custom reminder setting. Campaigns with a custom interval are not affected. To keep the old timing, set a custom interval of 3 days in the campaign's reminder settings.

What is happening to the grid layout for review widgets?

A new carousel layout is available for review widgets, and the grid layout will be removed at the end of the quarter. If your site uses a grid widget, switch it to the carousel layout before then. Custom styling written for the grid layout will not carry over.

Can I still export dashboards as PDF?

No. PDF export from dashboards has been removed. Dashboards can now be exported as CSV only, so if you used PDF exports, please use CSV instead.

Why are new survey responses appearing in Salesforce later than before?

Salesforce sync now runs every hour instead of every 15 minutes. This reduces the chance of reaching Salesforce limits. Teams working on survey responses in Salesforce may see new records up to an hour later than before.

Were the duplicate escalation emails and the scheduled campaign time zone problem fixed?

Yes. Escalation emails were being sent twice and are now sent once. Scheduled campaigns were sending in the wrong time zone and now send in your account's time zone. No action is needed for either.

Are there any performance improvements in this release?

Yes. Large reports now load up to 40% faster, and the survey preview now loads in under two seconds. No action is needed.
